title: Icala Lomlilo Ongcwele
intro: Ezweni lasendulo lapho ukuzinikela etsheni eliqoshiwe kwakugxile khona kuzo zonke izindlu, umuntu oyedwa wayema ​​ehlukile. Ngokuqiniseka okungenakunyakaziswa kanye nesivikelo saphezulu, babhekana nokufa okwakufanele kube yiqiniso - futhi bahamba bengenamyocu. Ungakwazi yini ukuthola ukuthi ungubani lo mphefumulo omangalisayo?
clues: Ngakhulela phakathi kwabantu ababekhothamela izithombe ababeziqophe ngezandla zabo, bekholelwa ukuthi lezi zinto zinamandla aphezulu.
Lapho ngiphikisa izinkolelo zabo, baqale bangilahla, kodwa angikwazanga ukuthula ngeqiniso engangilazi.
Ngosuku lapho bebuthene khona, ngabhubhisa izithombe zabo, ngashiya esikhulu kunazo zonke kuphela esingathintekile.
Lapho bebuya bebona engangikwenzile, abaholi babo bayala ukuba kwakhiwe i-firere enkulu, behlose ukungiphonsa emlilweni.
Bangiphonsa emlilweni ovuthayo, kodwa iNkosi yamazwe yayala ukuba kuphole futhi kuphephe kimi.
Ngaphuma elangabini ngingalimalanga nhlobo, kuyilapho labo ababengiceba bebhekene nokubhujiswa okukhulu.
